items.html: Indeed, the light that was initially below and ascended, remained afterwards forever in the Chazeh and did not come down in the Parsa. However, since they are up there, and they are pressed there, they elicited branches from them, through the Einayim, and these are the Nekudim that expanded outside of AK from the Tabur to the Sium Raglayim, and this is their essence. However, that new light that descended in its internality through the Parsa also breaches the vessel and the Guf of AK and shines in these Nekudim, both through the holes in the hair, as well as through the Tabur and the Yesod. It follows that this new light breaches twice: 1) through the Parsa, and 2) through the walls of the vessels of AK.
